title: CORE: Coarse-to-Fine Search with Context Management for Deep Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.07859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep research agents answer complex questions through repeated search. They rely on a harness that runs their tool calls and returns evidence to their context. This creates a trade-off: Search works best over long passages, which give enough context for reliable semantic matching. But the returned evidence should be short, because every observation stays in the agent's context for the rest of the trajectory. We introduce CORE, a training-free harness that combines coarse-to-fine search with context management. CORE retrieves passages with a dense retriever. It then reuses the token-level similarities from a late-interaction reranker to return only the most relevant snippet from each passage. Context management lets the agent expand the context around sources it has already retrieved and suppresses repeated snippets. translated_title: CORE：面向深度研究的粗粒度到细粒度搜索与上下文管理
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体通过反复搜索来回答复杂问题。它们依赖于一个执行工具调用并将证据返回到其上下文的框架（harness）。这带来了一种权衡：搜索在长段落上效果最佳，因为长段落能为可靠的语义匹配提供足够的上下文；但返回的证据应当简短，因为每条观察结果都会保留在智能体的上下文中，贯穿其后的整个轨迹。我们提出了CORE，一个无需训练的框架，它将粗粒度到细粒度的搜索与上下文管理相结合。CORE使用稠密检索器检索段落，然后复用后期交互（late-interaction）重排序器的词元级相似度，仅返回每个段落中最相关的片段。上下文管理使智能体能够围绕已检索的来源扩展上下文，并抑制重复片段。在与通义DeepResearch和OpenResearcher框架的受控封闭搜索对比中，CORE达到了最先进的性能……
tldr: CORE是一个无需训练的深度研究框架，通过将粗到细搜索与上下文管理相结合，解决了搜索需要长上下文与返回证据应简短之间的权衡，实现了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: CORE is a training-free harness for deep research that combines coarse-to-fine search with context management to resolve the trade-off between long-passage search and short returned evidence, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
